nodes: Prove some fixed delta>0 with zeta(s) nonzero for Re(s)>1-delta.
Control completed adverse debt divided by retained carrier on the same state.
A representation change which preserves this quotient is not progress.
Linear matrix, quantum, character and free lifts scalarize to the same Wiener cost.
Only genuinely all-channel nonlinear coercivity can escape.
A degree-k tensor uses arithmetic length Y^k; the audited aperture is below Y^2.
The first nontrivial tensor layer is unavailable.
Centering, differentiation and high-pass filtering move but do not delete the Mertens principal mode.
Positive Husimi smoothing obeys sigma_p sigma_T>=1 and adds an unpolarized carrier.
Exact recovery is signed backward heat.
Common DPP determinants cancel; directional Christoffel leverage remains.
Estimate the Schur ratio, not either determinant.
A remote symmetric prime factor preserves every finite Lambda head while inserting a candidate quartet.
Every candidate certificate needs a nonlocal completion or AFE tail.
Prime atomic extremal squared equals a maximum weighted Schur complement.
An optimal real-cosine design uses at most M+1 support points.
Actual-prime hat quadrature gives error O((1+t^2)Y^(-19/20)).
It certifies exponent .019 through t=Y^.4655; the rest of the aperture remains open.
The polar theta remainder R is strictly negative and r=-R=8 exp(-|.|)*Phi.
This gives a positive configuration kernel but a signed Wigner slice.
The full B_P Poisson completion is +bulk-axis-axis+corner.
Finite, axiswise, and primal-dual orbit Gram decompositions fail.
Theta S2 positivity, fractional tails, and S2 one-crossing are false.
Arb gives +,-,+ at T=152.7; this does not falsify integrated S3.
Finite-head and prime-separable machine SOS cannot identify the candidate implication.
Common-height cross-prime coherence and a nonlocal tail are necessary.
Ordinary density, universality, and global Speiser counts tolerate one offender or lose winding.
A per-zero depth-local mechanism is still open.
A zero of multiplicity m cannot by itself force reverse Husimi localization when 2m eta<=alpha.
The exact monomial ratio loses to the linear Husimi cost at every smoothing scale; only global cofactor variation remains.
The additive primal plus dual AFE lift cannot be made stable by any coordinatewise invertible real GL2 holographic transform.
Its exact two-prime Rayleigh minor changes sign; only cross-channel transforms or non-product complex cones survive.
Control the actual-prime high-tail antenna from Y^(19/40-eps) to Y^(50/33).
Prove E_Y<=Y^-c with c>.0180303234 to kill the prime route, or a subpower lower bound to promote it.
Prove every actual-theta B_P is positive definite.
Simple orbit Grams and one-crossing are closed; only infinite global modular mixing remains.
At a hypothetical outer zero prove Husimi reverse localization with the exact exp(-4s^2 alpha eta) cost.
The zero jet alone is not enough; a global coefficient-relative estimate is required.
Construct a same-state candidate certificate with the exact nonlocal AFE/completion remainder.
A finite coefficient head is nonidentifying.
A full-aperture actual-prime dual antenna has error Y^-c for some c>.0180303234.
The first Y^.4655 of the band is proved; H1 is exactly the remaining high tail.
The complete actual-theta B_P family is positive definite.
The one-crossing subhypothesis is closed, not H2.
An outer zero plus the complete theta or zeta cofactor forces the strict reverse of the known Husimi inequality.
This is live but criterion-strength; the local zero and every fixed multiplicity are insufficient.
The full AFE Loewner operator factors into a signed carrier gap plus a uniformly smaller exact remainder.
An unrestricted remainder is vacuous; rank-two displacement and finite Loewner data alone are closed.
A legal design with q in the Gram range has q*G^dagger q=Y^o via a nonvacuous directional adelic factorization.
Local factors need independent lower bounds, actual-node transfer, and the pseudoinverse range condition.
A completed arithmetic transfer determinant with a zero-free prefactor has a gap on the principal parabolic cusp channel.
Generic FUP and compact observability miss that channel.
One outer zero has winding-preserving replication into more distinct actual zeros than density permits.
Near-zeros require a bounded-overlap Rouche conversion; the principal value must also be transported.
Actual tau-Li coefficients force exterior-pole negativity and arithmetic nonnegativity on the same syndetic degree set.
This is criterion-strength; endpoint transport and absolute Laguerre bounds are closed.
A depth-local Speiser tree terminates in a count violation or a proved derivative zero-free region.
Depth amplification alone, Gauss-Lucas, and aggregate derivative counts are insufficient.
A full-remainder AFE becomes stable under an explicit nonlocal cross-channel transform on a proper non-product complex cone.
Every coordinatewise real product-half-plane holographic transform is now closed.
